question: Which country has the MOST World Cup titles?

post.premise: Five World Cups and the only team at every tournament
post.bait: Brazil, Germany or Italy — which did you pick? 👇

intent: A stadium announcer reading the record book: numbers first, then the one defeat that still hurts.

v04.text: Brazil. Five titles, from 1958 to 2002. Nobody else has more than four.

v05.text: Brazil is also the only team at all 22 World Cups, never missing one since 1930.

v06.text: Pelé won his first at 17, still the youngest champion ever.

v07.text: And the one that hurt: 1950, the final lost at home in the Maracanã, two hundred thousand watching.

v08.text: Nobody has more stars. Follow us.

research.topic: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cups? (Brazil, 5)

myths.myth: Germany has the most World Cup titles.
myths.reality: Germany and Italy have four each; Brazil has five (1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, 2002).

landscape.our_gap: Feed answers flash 'Brazil 5' over a stock photo; nobody puts the five years, the 22-of-22 record, Pelé's birthplace and the 1950 Maracanã on one moving map.
